adaptation.effort_notes: New standard-library implementation of fixed-history-v0 with a synchronous JSONL broker bridge; no SDK defaults. Implementation status and measured verification are maintained in probes/core_self/README.md.

changes.default_behavior: SDK provider model integrations and optional global model cache
changes.adapted_behavior: Custom BaseChatModel delegates every request to the parent JSONL broker; cache=False
changes.reason: The parent fixes model identity, parameters and tool definitions and observes every model request

changes.default_behavior: SDK AIMessage stores normalized content and parsed tool-call arguments
changes.adapted_behavior: Retain raw assistant message in additional_kwargs and restore it for broker history; SDK receives parsed scheduling objects
changes.reason: Preserve null content, exact tool IDs and raw argument strings without leaking SDK metadata

changes.default_behavior: Caller-supplied graph messages; optional checkpointer for persistence
changes.adapted_behavior: Adapter stores separate full SDK-message histories per session, including failed turns; reset clears session history and transient state; no checkpointer
changes.reason: fixed-history-v0 requires interleaved sessions, complete history and explicit reset

changes.default_behavior: ToolNode can fan out calls and validate/invoke registered StructuredTools
changes.adapted_behavior: graph.invoke(max_concurrency=1); ToolNode wrap_tool_call middleware delegates raw parsed arguments to parent tools, bypassing registered handler and SDK coercion
changes.reason: The contract requires serial broker execution with exact original IDs and argument values

changes.default_behavior: ToolNode emits SDK-specific validation and unknown-tool messages; provider tools determine result shape
changes.adapted_behavior: Malformed JSON/non-object arguments become invalid_arguments; all parseable requests including unknown tools go to broker; preserve ok/result or ok/error only, detect invalid_result, never retry
changes.reason: Return protocol-defined structured errors to the model; create_agent drives the subsequent recovery model request

changes.default_behavior: create_agent graph recursion guard counts graph supersteps
changes.adapted_behavior: Before each broker model request enforce per-turn model-call limit and Unicode content context budget; service_managed with null context_limit has no local character limit; exception ends graph
changes.reason: Graph supersteps are not model requests and Story context is managed by its service

changes.default_behavior: Graph exits when the assistant has no tool calls
changes.adapted_behavior: Tool calls proceed only for tool_calls finish_reason; completion requires stop finish_reason and string content; preserve abnormal replies in history, return failed without dispatching tools; budget errors return their protocol status
changes.reason: API truncation and model-service failure must not masquerade as successful completion or trigger tools

changes.default_behavior: SDK tracing can be enabled by inherited environment settings
changes.adapted_behavior: Disable LANGSMITH_TRACING and LANGCHAIN_TRACING_V2 in the worker before SDK import
changes.reason: Keep external I/O within the parent broker and avoid exporting benchmark content

adaptation.effort_notes: Two production Python files implement JSONL transport, BaseChatModel and ToolNode middleware; create_agent graph owns actual model/tool orchestration. Fixed SDK versions and transitive dependencies are in root uv.lock. This probe uses synchronous invocation, one active turn, no checkpointer and only serial/recover/error/0; SDK upgrades require regression checks of raw-message roundtrip, scheduling and middleware behavior. Source size, installed package count and measured wall-clock milestones are in README; no human-hour estimate.
